_source: Ball Pit Brawl - Game Design Spec.pdf (Reference_For_Future_MP_Games). Numbers from the spec's tables; where the OCR lost a cell the default is noted in docs/BALLPIT_PROGRESS.md.

guns.name: Dual mini blasters
guns.role: Fast close-range spray; no aiming down sights

guns.name: Pump scatter blaster
guns.role: Close-range bursts in tunnels and on decks

guns.name: Mega dart crossbow
guns.role: One huge dart with heavy drop; knocks the target back 1 m

guns.name: Belt-fed heavy blaster
guns.role: Holds a doorway; slows you to 80% speed

guns.name: Long-range blaster
guns.role: Across the atrium; low dart drop

guns.name: Foam rocket launcher
guns.role: Clears decks and campers; slow rocket is easy to dodge

rewards.name: Instant dart refill
rewards.text: Fills your magazine and dart reserve, and any teammates' within 10 m

rewards.name: Placeable health box
rewards.text: A first-aid box on the deck: teammates who touch it heal 50. Lasts 60 s or 5 uses
rewards.counter: Destroy it with 3 darts or 1 ball

rewards.name: Swarm of annoying kids
rewards.text: 8 shrieking kids flood the enemy half for 30 s: in front of enemies, crowding slides and ladders, splashing in pits
rewards.counter: They can't be hurt; wait them out or go around

rewards.name: RC car drone
rewards.text: Drive a remote-control car with a dart turret (10 damage, 4 shots/s) for 45 s. It has 50 health; your body stands still
rewards.counter: Shoot the car, or find and knock out the driver

rewards.name: Flying dart drone
rewards.text: A drone hovers over you for 30 s and fires at any enemy it can see (8 damage, 3 shots/s)
rewards.counter: Shoot it down (80 health) or break line of sight; nets block its darts

rewards.name: Dart tank
rewards.text: Ride a padded toy tank for 40 s: twin flywheel blasters (15 damage, 10 shots/s) and 400 armor. Ground floor and the wide level 2 decks only
rewards.counter: Stay on narrow upper decks it can't reach; focus it with balls

jokes.name: Party horn
jokes.text: One loud toot and a little noise-maker animation

jokes.name: Juice box
jokes.text: You drink it with an extremely long slurp

jokes.name: Dad joke card
jokes.text: Shows a random terrible joke on your teammates' screens

jokes.name: Confetti popper
jokes.text: A burst of confetti that vanishes in 2 s

jokes.name: Whoopee cushion
jokes.text: Place it on a deck; the next teammate to step on it sets it off

jokes.name: Rubber chicken
jokes.text: Throw it; it bounces around squawking and does nothing else

jokes.name: Capsule machine toy
jokes.text: A random cheap plastic prize with a silly name, added to your collection

jokes.name: Paper birthday crown
jokes.text: Put it on a teammate's head for the rest of their life

jokes.name: Giant foam finger
jokes.text: Wave it around for 10 s in place of your weapon

jokes.name: Propeller beanie
jokes.text: The propeller spins faster the faster you run

dad_jokes: Why did the ball pit file a complaint? It was tired of being taken for granted... and for grabs.
I'd tell you a joke about foam darts, but it would go over your head. Then drop. A lot.
What do you call a slide that tells jokes? A pun-tube.
I used to hate cargo nets. Then they grew on me. Mostly on my shins.
Why don't cannons ever win arguments? They always lose their balls.
My kid asked for a vacuum for his birthday. Honestly it sucked.
What's a ball pit's favourite music? Anything with a lot of bounce.
I tried to catch some fog yesterday. Mist.
Why was the rope bridge so calm? It knew how to hang in there.
The store only sells darts by the dozen. I asked why. They said it was a pack-tical decision.
Did you hear about the crawl tunnel? It's a real low point in my career.
Why did the dart go to therapy? It kept falling short of expectations.

modes.name: Free for all
modes.goal: Most knockouts: first to 25, or the most after 10 minutes

modes.name: Team deathmatch
modes.goal: Team knockouts: first team to 50, or the most after 10 minutes

modes.name: Capture the flag
modes.goal: Take the enemy flag from their roof to your own: first to 3, or the most after 15 minutes

modes.name: Disarm the bomb
modes.goal: Attackers plant the foam bomb in the defenders' tower; defenders stop or disarm it. First to 7 rounds; sides swap at round 6
